description: Perilux — the project home for dental-assistant skills training, built in the open by the AGI Future Foundation: a three-session training programme (Prevention & School Screening, Chairside Assisting Basics, Sterilization & Operatory Setup), a six-station VR simulator blueprint (A-F) designed with reference to CODA, DANB, CDC and ADEA competencies, a playable browser-based VR clinic prototype, and an open prototype offer to the Unspoken Smiles Foundation.

framing.label: Demo program inspired by Unspoken Smiles' public work — not an official Unspoken Smiles program, not endorsed by or affiliated with Unspoken Smiles. No partnership, pilot, or contact is claimed. The demo does not license or certify anyone, and it holds no patient data.
framing.standards_wording: designed with reference to — never compliant with or accredited by

name: Perilux

status.note: Site built 2026-11-11; push and the perilux.pro DNS repoint to GitHub Pages are a separate watched step, not yet fired. The VR demo is live on GitHub Pages (verified 2026-11-11) at https://agifuturefoundation.github.io/UnspokenSmiled-VR/ — a prototype: one fully playable session, magic-window browser view, no WebXR session built, no recorded walkthrough video yet. This site has no API, no MCP server, and no payment endpoints.

vr_demo.playable_session: Prevention & School Screening (9 steps, fully playable end to end)
